name: Australian Apprentice Training Support Payment (AATSP)
provider: Department of Employment and Workplace Relations
summary: Commonwealth payment made to apprentices in priority occupations, paid in instalments over the first two years.
key: Full-time apprentices get $625 at each of 6, 12, 18 and 24 months; part-time apprentices get $310 to $315 per instalment.
catches: Amounts come from the payments table in the DEWR overview; eligibility is set out in the Australian Apprenticeships Incentive System Program Guidelines (22 Dec 2025 to 31 Dec 2026).
Not paid on top of the Key Apprenticeship Program apprentice incentive for the same apprenticeship.

source.label: DEWR: Australian Apprenticeships Incentive System payments overview

evidence.quote: Payments at 6 months 12 months 18 months 24 months
Effective as of 1 July 2026

name: Key Apprenticeship Program apprentice incentive
provider: Department of Employment and Workplace Relations
summary: Commonwealth payments to apprentices in clean energy or housing construction occupations, paid at milestones through to completion.
key: $2,000 per payment for full-time and $1,000 for part-time apprentices, at 6, 12, 24 and 36 months and on completion.
who: Certificate III or higher apprenticeship linked to a clean energy or housing construction priority outcome
Employer works in that sector and both sign a commitment declaration
catches: Amounts are from the payments table; check the program guidelines before relying on them.
Cannot be paid together with the Australian Apprentice Training Support Payment for the same apprenticeship.

source.label: DEWR: Australian Apprenticeships Incentive System payments overview

evidence.quote: Payments at 6, 12, 24, 36 months and on completion

name: Living Away From Home Allowance (LAFHA) for apprentices
provider: Department of Employment and Workplace Relations
summary: Weekly Commonwealth allowance for apprentices who move out of their parent's or guardian's home for the first time for their apprenticeship.
key: $125.52 a week in year one, $94.14 in year two and $47.07 in year three.
who: Apprentices who must move away from their parent's or guardian's home for the first time
Within 36 months of the apprenticeship start date (commencements from 1 January 2026)
Apprentices who are homeless may also be eligible
catches: Not payable to anyone getting Youth Allowance, Austudy, ABSTUDY, Centrelink rent assistance, or free or subsidised accommodation from their employer.
Weekly amounts are from the payments table in the overview.

source.label: DEWR: Australian Apprenticeships Incentive System payments overview

evidence.quote: Available to apprentices who need to move away from their parent's or guardian's home for the first time to:
Apprentice must be within 36 months of the commencement date of their apprenticeship.

name: Australian Apprenticeship Support Loan (AASL)
provider: Department of Employment and Workplace Relations
summary: Interest-free Commonwealth loan for apprentices in priority occupations, repaid through the tax system once income passes a threshold.
key: Apprentices may borrow up to $27,048 (2026/27) interest free over a 4-year apprenticeship.
who: Apprenticeship in an occupation on the Australian Apprenticeships Priority List
catches: Repayments start once income reaches $69,528 (2026/27).
The balance is cut by 20% when the apprenticeship is completed.

source.label: DEWR: Australian Apprenticeships Incentive System payments overview

evidence.quote: The Apprentice may borrow up to $27,048 (2026/27) interest free (annually indexed) over their 4-year apprenticeship.

name: NSW apprentice travel and accommodation allowance (VTAS)
summary: NSW pays apprentices and new entrant trainees per kilometre and per night when they travel far for day or block release training.
key: From 1 November 2025, $0.52 per km travel and $70 per night accommodation.
who: Registered in NSW as an apprentice or new entrant trainee with a NSW workplace
Travel more than 110 km return for day or block release training
how: Complete the VTAS form, sign it, have your RTO sign and endorse it, and lodge it with your local Training Services NSW office.
catches: Claims must be submitted by 30 June following the year of travel.
Claims submitted after 1 November 2025 are not backdated to the new rates.

source.label: NSW Department of Education: Travel, accommodation and relocation assistance package

evidence.quote: per km travel rate $0.52
accommodation rate $70 per night
VTAS claims must be submitted by 30 June following the year of travel.

name: NSW CAPS relocation payment for apprentices

who: Registered with the Continuing Apprentices and Trainees Placement Service (CAPS), with a CAPS-registered new employer
Relocate more than 60 km and hold a valid training contract
how: Email the relocation and rental assistance application form to CAPS@det.nsw.edu.au.
catches: Claim within 6 months of the new training contract start or transfer date.
